decision_variable_count: [Факт зі статті] N variables per chromosome. Eligible experiments use N=32, 64, 128, and 256 for N-Queens and N=32, 64, 124, and 254 for random TSP; therefore every principal reported experiment has at least 32 variables. Article §§3–5, Figures 1, 2, 5, and 7: https://www.mdpi.com/1999-4893/14/1/16
decision_variables: [Факт зі статті] N-Queens: complete indexed set q_1, q_2, ..., q_N, where q_j is the row of the queen in column j; N∈{32,64,128,256} in Figure 5 (§3 and §5.1).
[Факт зі статті] TSP: complete indexed permutation π_1, π_2, ..., π_N of city labels, where index j is route position; N∈{32,64,124,254} in §5.2/Figure 7, plus a 48-city test in §4.
ga_hyperparameter_count: Не вказано (стаття не подає одного вичерпного зведеного переліку; нижче наведені встановлені параметри).
ga_hyperparameters: [Факт зі статті] crossover method and crossover fraction

[Факт зі статті] minimum nonzero gene probability (§3)
[Факт зі статті] stopping criterion / generation count
adaptive_parameters: [Факт зі статті] Per-gene mutation-selection probability p_j, recomputed from gene partial fitness relative to the other genes; worse genes receive larger probability and every gene retains a nonzero probability (§3, Equation 6, Algorithm 2).
adaptive_parameter_count: 1 parameter family with N gene-local values
adaptation_category: A + E: single-mechanism, feedback-based gene/locus-level adaptive mutation
adaptation_timing: [Факт зі статті] Gene probabilities are customized within each chromosome before locus mutation; the adaptive values are not a once-per-run schedule. Algorithm 2, §3.
adaptation_formulas: [Факт зі статті] Equation (6): p_{t,i,j} is a function of the partial fitness of the selected gene; the article explains that probabilities are proportional to the genes' relative partial losses and include a nonzero floor. Exact equation artwork is retained in the official PDF and is not re-transcribed here to avoid inventing omitted symbols.
[Факт зі статті] N-Queens partial loss for q_j is the number of queens attacked by that queen; the worked vector is [1,2,2,1,0,0,1,1] (§3, Figure 1).
[Факт зі статті] TSP normalized comparative loss is Equation (7), comparing the current route edge with that city's nearest and farthest possible edges (§4).
[Факт зі статті] §5.4 raises partial fitness to a power; power=0 recovers uniform mutation and larger power increasingly concentrates mutation on the worst loci.
adaptive_initial_values: [Факт зі статті] The global mutation factor is set to 1 in the locus-isolation experiments (§3, Algorithm 2 discussion). Gene-local probabilities are derived from each chromosome's current partial-fitness vector, so no single scalar initial p_j is specified.
adaptive_min_values: [Факт зі статті] A nonzero floor is required; §5.4 illustrates adding 0.001 to every gene. The paper does not state that 0.001 is a universal bound for every experiment.
adaptive_max_values: Не вказано as a fixed scalar; probabilities are normalized relative weights determined by the current chromosome.
update_frequency: [Факт зі статті] At each locus-mutation application after partial fitness has been calculated; Algorithm 2, §3.
update_order: [Факт зі статті] Initialize/evaluate population → select elite/parents → crossover → compute partial gene fitness → probabilistically select/mutate loci → evaluate next generation; Algorithm 2, §3.
adaptation_input_metrics: relative partial fitness of the other loci in the same chromosome
problem-specific partial loss (queen conflicts or normalized comparative route-edge loss)
parameter_interdependence: [Факт зі статті] All p_j values are mutually coupled through relative normalization within the chromosome; the optional power reshapes the same partial-fitness distribution. The paper states locus mutation can also be combined with population- or individual-level adaptation, but those combinations are not the main experiments (§3).

fitness_function: [Факт зі статті] N-Queens loss: number of attacking queen pairs; optimum is 0 (§3, Figure 1).
[Факт зі статті] TSP loss: total route length; gene partial fitness uses normalized comparative loss, Equation (7), §4.

[Факт зі статті] TSP uses a valid permutation representation and problem-specific crossover/mutation so each city occurs once.

dataset_or_benchmark: 16 TSPLIB instances with fewer than 101 cities

inclusion_or_exclusion_reason: [Висновок] Included: 2021 legal OA article, qualifying Hungarian EU affiliation, 32–256 decision variables, explicit gene-level adaptive operator, equations/pseudocode/update order, reconstructible benchmarks, repeated experiments, and official MIT-licensed Python code.

mathematical_description.evidence: Equations (1)–(7), Algorithms 1–2, and worked examples specify the method, but the paper/code floor and some TSP semantics are not fully uniform.

experimental_parameter_description.evidence: Sizes, rate grid, populations, generations, and repetitions are reported, but Table 1 does not map its single cells to the two stated populations and the TSP generation count differs from code.

legal_data_availability.evidence: The selected N-Queens reproduction is deterministic and needs no external dataset; bundled TSPLIB files are excluded unless separately licensed.

seeds_and_run_count.evidence: Run counts of 10, 50, or 100 are reported, but neither the paper nor released scripts provide a seed ledger.

open_code.evidence: Official scripts are public, but the mutation-rate setter is applied after each labeled sweep cell, auxiliary scripts contain undefined names, and no locked environment/raw-run export is supplied.

code_license_quality.evidence: MIT LICENSE at audited revision 7e13ea43861203637b50320226a19e24689a20ff permits an attributed MATLAB port.

intermediate_result_verifiability.evidence: Tables and convergence/timing/power figures provide intermediate targets, but per-run numeric arrays, seeds, and machine-readable curve data are absent.

adaptive_parameter_completeness.evidence: The locus distribution and power behavior are recoverable, but the global MutationRate and Pow remain fixed within a run and the documented floor is configuration-dependent.

update_order_clarity.evidence: The operator order is recoverable from Algorithm 2 and code, with a material code-only geometric while-loop mutation semantic that must be declared.

baseline_ga.evidence: Matched traditional uniform-mutation baseline throughout Figures 4–10.

ablation_study.evidence: Power=0 supplies the uniform limit, §5.4 sweeps Pow, and Figure 6 compares traditional, individual-adaptive, and locus mutation.

[audit 2026-07-30] Equations (12)–(13) define S_T=−Σ_i^L p_i log p_i after dividing the solution space into L equal spaces, but L, multidimensional bin construction, boundaries, and empty-bin handling are absent.

[audit 2026-07-30] Equation (15) prints nAccept=(p%+p%/T)N with p=20%, but gives no rounding rule. Acceptance is invoked only when T mod K=0.
[audit 2026-07-30] Equation (16) prints P_k(T)=α+β·v_k(T−1)/v(T−1) at T mod K=0 and requires β+αN_k=1 for N_k=3. Prose gives β=0.7; Table 6 gives β=0.3.

[audit 2026-07-30] T starts at 1 and p=20%, but acceptance first executes at T=5 because K=5, yielding 24% of N before unspecified rounding rather than a 40% operative initial acceptance.
[Факт зі статті] P_k(1)=1/N_k=1/3 for the three knowledge sources; α=0.1, while β is 0.7 in prose and 0.3 in Table 6.
adaptive_min_values: [paper claim, not executable] n is said to begin at 1; its actual lower-bound behavior is not verifiable without valid D_T, D_max, S_max, and an integer convention.
